name: thk
description: The Hand of the King — a ticket-to-Draft-PR orchestrator that runs as a Claude Code plugin. Captures context (ticket source MCP — Linear today, Jira later; plus Jam, Figma, PlanetScale, Notion), drafts a plan, optionally summons a Small Council of reviewers, executes the plan as a single agent, opens a Draft PR. Pluggable surfaces: ticket source MCP and council/counselor runners (Claude / Codex CLI / Gemini CLI via profiles). The Hand itself is host-bound to Claude Code.
